preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree, n, is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(0 <= p_i <= i for i, p_i in enumerate(p))
preconditions.description: The tree is described by a parent array p of length n-1, where p_i is the parent of vertex i+1 (0-based), and 0 ≤ p_i ≤ i for each i.

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n and all(x_i in {0, 1} for x_i in x)
preconditions.description: The color array x has length n, with each x_i being 0 (white) or 1 (black).
At least one vertex is colored black.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7, representing the number of valid edge sets modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for k in range(0, n) for edges in combinations(edges_in_tree, k) if all(connected_component_has_exactly_one_black(edges, tree, x, i) for i in range(1, k + 2)))) % 10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all possible sets of k edges (0 ≤ k < n) whose removal splits the tree into (k + 1) connected components, where each component contains exactly one black vertex. The count is taken modulo 10^9 + 7.
